## Required Before Requesting Review

- [ ] `npm run lint:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run format:check` passes
- [ ] `npm run type-check` passes
- [ ] No `console.log` statements
- [ ] No `any` types
- [ ] No `throw` literals
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (if user-facing)
